correctness.rationale: For distinct nonempty rectangles, equality of nonzero products would force both supports equal, so commuting means both cross-products vanish. At a coordinate, simultaneous left/right membership can therefore only be the private overlap of a single idempotent. Inclusion–exclusion on missing nilpotent supports and missing private overlaps gives F_n(k,h); the partition-lattice Möbius sum from the discrete partition gives the signed first-kind Stirling coefficient, then division by k!j! unlabels both classes. For maximality, an unused coordinate admits a new diagonal rectangle; under full aggregate coverage the only possible additions have left support in L=U\V and right in R=V\U. All those rectangles are mutually compatible and mandatory. The shared coordinates partition into nonempty private idempotent overlaps, and the support decorations give exactly the two nontrivial W cases. If either one-sided region is empty, coverage must come from idempotents; the k=0 exception gives no spurious empty facet for n>=1. The empty clique and the zero-adjunction correspondence are valid in the stated semigroup.
residual_risks: Replay exhausts n=1–4, checking refined coefficients including internal zero coefficients and maximal histograms; n=4 reproduces 6042 cliques and 725 facets. The all-n conclusion uses the proof, not extrapolation.
